description: Source code implementing a terminal interface for PLS/UDE debugger, including serial communication functions and JTAG access handling.

classes.name: tagSimioAccess
classes.description: Structure representing JTAG simulation I/O access with control and data registers.

methods.name: sendBuffer
methods.description: Sends a buffer of specified length over JTAG interface.

methods.name: UDE_Write
methods.description: Writes data to the serial interface, handling carriage return to newline conversion.

methods.name: RcveChar
methods.description: Receives a character from the JTAG interface, waiting for data availability.

methods.name: UDE_Read
methods.description: Reads data from the serial interface, converting line endings.
